method: Independent code, only isolated design builders loaded. No geometry.py/public runtime import. Rectangle clipping is exact for line/box and line/linear-ramp. Standing support uses 97 radial samples; objectives are point markers with reviewer assumed r=.675/h=1.6 body, not full game objects.

geometricSightlines.note: Sparse review witnesses only. Straight zero-width rays, solid floor/ramp/cover volumes. Grates ignored. No weapon range, gravity, spread, ink, animation, camera boom, posture, reaction or team simulation. Clear does not mean hittable or dominant.
